text:
maria: quick evening watch turnover — short summary of what happened earlier and who is taking next steps. Brief: around 16:08 we saw a spike in 503s for embedding requests (model=embed-fast) routed to ap-sg. Root cause looked like autoscaler thrash + redis read-pool saturation; some nodes hit memory pressure and C10/C11 retried and pushed load to secondary pools.

incident-bot: Pager: `autoscaler-oscillation-ap-sg` triggered (link: https://incidents.redwood/internal/alerts/AS-1765). 503 p95 ~26s, error rate peaked at 3.1% for 10m.

maria: Mitigations taken: scaled dedicated-pool-embeddings + temporarily pinned routing to embed-slow-fallback for ap-sg (policy=soft-fallback). Disabled aggressive scale-down for the autoscaler (minReplicas bumped to 4). Cleared some noisy keys from redis read-pool (see playbook step 3).

maria: Current status: error rate down to 0.25% last 5m, latency p95 back to expected ~120ms on fallback model. No customers in outage, a small increase in tail latency for a handful of enterprise tenants.

derek: taking primary for next 4h. I’ll monitor autoscaler graphs + node memory. I’ll keep the minReplicas change until 02:00 UTC unless we see stabilization. :thumbsup:

sam: I’ll be secondary, watching the redis read-pool and embedding queue. If error rate creeps above 1% I’ll run `kubectl get pods -n infra | grep embed` and open a quick relaunch.

maria: runbook pointers: https://confluence.redwood/internal/runbooks/autoscaler-oscillation — follow the checklist under "Evening watch". Quick commands if needed:
```
# scale pool up
kubectl scale deployment/dedicated-pool-embeddings -n inference --replicas=6
# set min replicas on HPA
kubectl patch hpa/autoscaler-embeds -n inference -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":4}}'
```

claudia: CS note: I’ll send an FYI to affected workspace owners (small tail latency) and tell them we’ve implemented a soft fallback. Will share the message here once posted.

maria: Next steps / owners: derek (primary) — keep minReplicas until stabilized; sam (secondary) — watch redis and be ready to relaunch pods; claudia (CS) — customer comms. Postmortem owner: maria. Estimated postmortem ETA EOD tomorrow.

maria: Handoff checklist for the person coming on at 00:00 UTC: 1) verify error rate <0.5% for 30m, 2) check autoscaler events and HPA, 3) confirm minReplicas change and decide rollback plan (rollback steps in runbook), 4) confirm CS message live. If anything degrades immediately escalate to oncall-sre.

derek: noted. I’ll mark the watch in the handoff doc and ping if anything changes.

sam: all good from me, I added a quick grafana dashboard bookmark: https://grafana.redwood/d/embeds/quick-watch

maria: thanks team — leaving this thread pinned to night-handoff. :white_check_mark:
